title: Jailbird
synopsis: A chicken enters a human prison as part of an unusual rehabilitation program, revealing an unexpected bond between animals and inmates.
awards: Runway AI Film Festival — Gold, AIFF 2025

audienceReactions.quote: This is really impressive use of cutting edge tech in the service of storytelling, and hopefully an example of how film making survives and thrives in the future. Congrats on the award.
audienceReactions.author: @RichEdwards

audienceReactions.quote: Congrats on the Runway AIFF win! This had me hooked from the beginning.
